summary: Generate rich Markdown documentation with Mermaid diagrams for Salesforce flows
description: Scans for flow files and produces beautiful, readable documentation including interactive Mermaid flow diagrams, node details, variables, and parse errors.
flags.directory: Directory to scan for .flow-meta.xml files (default: current directory)
flags.files: Specific flow files to generate documentation for (multiple allowed)
flags.output: Write the generated documentation to a file instead of printing to console
flags.noDetails: Omit detailed node and variable tables (produces cleaner, diagram-focused output)
flags.raw: Output only the raw Mermaid code blocks with no surrounding Markdown text or headings
flags.collapsed: Collapse detailed sections (variables, node details) by default in the output
